METROPOLITAN BUSINESS JOURNAL
Oakridge Transit Authority Completes Phase II Extension
By Marcus Gallagher

OAKRIDGE — The Oakridge Regional Transit Authority (ORTA) officially opened the five-mile Silverline light rail extension this morning, connecting the downtown business core with the expanding Eastside Tech Park. The $320 million infrastructure project was completed two months ahead of schedule and $14 million under budget.

The new extension adds four elevated passenger stations: Oakridge Medical Center, Riverside Green, Innovation Way, and Eastside Terminal. Trains will operate every eight minutes during morning and evening rush hours, and every fifteen minutes during off-peak hours. Commute times between the downtown central station and Eastside Tech Park will be reduced from fifty minutes by automobile in heavy highway traffic to just eighteen minutes on the dedicated electric rail line.

City Council President Maya Lin noted that the transit line is expected to stimulate commercial and residential development along the eastern corridor. 'We have already approved zoning permits for three mixed-use residential complexes and two biomedical office parks adjacent to the Innovation Way station,' Lin announced at the ribbon-cutting ceremony.

To encourage local residents and tech workers to try the new service, ORTA is offering free rides across the entire Silverline throughout its first two weeks of operation.

VERTEX APPLIANCES — COMMERCIAL INDUCTION COOKTOP MODEL IC-400
User Maintenance Instructions & Limited Commercial Warranty

Operating Guidelines:
1. Power Requirements: Model IC-400 requires a dedicated 220V/20A electrical circuit. Do not operate on multi-outlet extension leads.
2. Cookware Compatibility: Use only cookware with a magnetic ferrous base (cast iron, enameled steel, or magnetic stainless steel) with flat bottoms measuring between 5.5 and 10 inches in diameter.
3. Cleaning Procedure: Disconnect power and allow the ceramic glass surface to cool completely before cleaning. Use only non-abrasive cream glass cleaners and a microfiber cloth. Do not immerse the unit in water or use steel wool pads.
4. Error Codes:
• E-01: Cooktop surface temperature exceeds safe operating threshold. Turn off unit and allow cooling for 15 minutes.
• E-02: Incompatible cookware detected. Verify cookware magnetism using the supplied test magnet.
• E-03: Voltage fluctuation detected. Verify circuit breaker stability.

Position: Senior Clinical Regulatory Affairs Associate
Department: Regulatory Affairs & Compliance
Closing Date: October 15, 2026

Nexus Biopharmaceuticals is seeking a Senior Clinical Regulatory Affairs Associate to support investigational drug filings with the US FDA and European EMA. The successful candidate will coordinate documentation for Phase II and III clinical trials, author regulatory briefing packages, and participate in formal agency meetings.

[DOCUMENT 2: ONLINE CUSTOMER REVIEW]
Rating: 4.0 / 5.0 Stars
Reviewer: Evelyn Montgomery, San Francisco, CA
Date of Stay: October 8–11, 2026

My husband and I spent our anniversary weekend at Serenity Cove in Pavilion 14. The natural setting is breathtaking—watching whales migrate from our private balcony while listening to the surf was truly unforgettable. Chef Julian's tasting menu at the Cliffside Dining Room was sublime, particularly the Monterey black cod.

The only drawback was the shuttle service upon our arrival. We arrived around 4:30 p.m. on Friday during a steady rain shower, and we had to wait nearly twenty-five minutes at the perimeter parking lot because only one electric shuttle van was operating. A luggage cart was also unavailable, so our suitcases were slightly damp by the time we reached our pavilion. Otherwise, the service was polite and responsive.

TO: Evelyn Montgomery
DATE: October 14, 2026
